conditions: Add to cart button is clicked for one product
items.expected: The clicked product's button changes to 'Remove' and the cart badge shows '1'

conditions: one product has been added to cart (Remove button shown, badge shows 1)
Remove button is clicked for that product
items.expected: The button changes back to 'Add to cart' and the cart badge disappears (is not shown)

conditions: one product has been added from the list
user navigates to another page (e.g. product detail) and returns to the list
items.expected: The previously added product still shows 'Remove' and the cart badge still shows '1'

conditions: axe-core scans the inventory list with WCAG A/AA rules
items.expected: No accessibility violations reported for the product list (violations array is empty)
